description: Evidence-led candidate clusters for pretransition critical accumulation, physical barrier breakthrough, dormant-capacity limiter release, rated-system progressive overload, nucleation-and-growth phase transition, and irreversible threshold crossing. Broad limit, extreme, awakening, transcendence, ascension, singularity, absolute, infinity, and evolution terms remain advisory by themselves.

visual_semantics.primary_visual_proposition: One bounded system remains intact while a readable driver accumulates toward a reference threshold and localized precursors show the remaining gap before transition.
An aligned subject or force initiates a localized rupture in a resisting barrier, opens a new aperture, and crosses through with displaced material and aftermath at the same contact point.
The same subject or system visibly disengages a functional limiter, allowing previously contained output to emerge from that same source with a local old-bound comparison and consequence.

A rated technical system receives sustained excess load, develops a localized thermal or deformation failure, and propagates that failure through connected dependencies toward protection action or functional loss.
One bounded specimen visibly contains a parent phase, multiple new-phase nuclei, and a propagating interface under a readable driving field so both phases coexist in one material system.
The same subject or process crosses a defined one-way threshold while its return path closes, collapses, or is consumed and a committed downstream consequence begins beyond it.
